disposition_basis: The B9.49 lexical false-PASS was reproduced exactly and its permanent regression returned REVIEW_REQUIRED. A second direct policy-injection false PASS was independently reproduced and the current code now rejects it; a receipt-map tampering reproduction was independently observed before private-state hardening and the current suite asserts caller mutation is rejected. No active production caller was found. Some required related suite reruns and final artifact-hash comparisons were not available after concurrent workspace changes; see report.

critical_findings.finding: Direct ClaimVerifier constructor accepted caller-supplied reviewer public keys, roles, criteria, and signed records, then returned overall PASS with semanticStatus PASS and ownerAcceptance ACCEPTED.
critical_findings.remediation: Module-private canonical-policy authority token; canonical fixed trust-policy factory; roadmap policies with semantic/owner links rejected unless built through the private authority factory; immutable criteria and instance.
critical_findings.regression: direct ClaimVerifier caller cannot inject roadmap reviewer trust keys => UNTRUSTED_ROADMAP_POLICY

critical_findings.finding: Direct public receipt-map mutation enabled an unexecuted deliberately failing test to be represented by a hand-built zero-exit receipt and receive PASS.
critical_findings.remediation: Command catalog and receipts moved to a module-private WeakMap; verifier instance and nested policy frozen.
critical_findings.regression: caller cannot forge or replace verifier execution receipts; assignment throws TypeError

entrypoint_classification.authoritative_production_claimverifier_c: NONE FOUND in repository executable source/config; cannot rule out external/manual consumers
entrypoint_classification.legacy_python: No package script, CI step, shell wrapper, test runner, or executable source caller found; the script itself remains directly executable and unsafe as an acceptance authority.
